name: Баллиста — иконка
subject: ONE compact fantasy BUILD MENU icon showing ONLY the building from second reference image, three-quarter composition, retain its wood/steel/brass materials and characteristic silhouette. SECOND image defines structure, NOT voxel rendering: convert to crisp rich 2D PIXEL ILLUSTRATION like first image. No construction arrows, ground, NPC, tool overlay, text or surrounding scene. ONE heavy fantasy BALLISTA on a squat gray stone-and-iron square pedestal that is its INTRINSIC firing mount. Broad dark-oak crossbow limbs extend symmetrically left and right, visibly taut bowstring joins both limb tips behind a thick loaded bolt, bolt head points forward and fletching stays at rear. Thick stock, guide rail, swivel, iron braces and side winding crank. Physical crossbow string geometry coherent in ALL views. No surrounding ground, demonstration plinth or scene.
caption: Пиксельная иконка меню строительства, согласованная с пятиракурсным референсом этой постройки.
